title: Exact Inference in Fixed-Effect Regressions with Concentrated Identifying Variation
abstract: arXiv:2608.04839v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In fixed-effect regressions with many groups, fixed effects can absorb most identifying variation, leaving a handful of observations to carry what remains. When variation is this concentrated, conventional $t$-tests can reject a true null more than half the time, and any fixed critical value is either invalid or so conservative it has essentially no power. This paper builds an exact test from the design alone. A \textit{nuisance-annihilating contrast} is a linear combination of the treatment and fixed-effect dummies that eliminates the fixed effects without touching the outcome; sign-flipping these contrasts is then an exact symmetry of the null distribution at every sample size, under arbitrary heteroskedasticity. In two-way designs --- worker-firm, firm-time --- these contrasts are exactly the cycles of the bipartite mobility graph, so the movement that identifies the treatment effect is what makes exact inference possible. Exactne

translated_title: 固定效应回归中集中识别变异的精确推断
translated_abstract: 在具有许多组的固定效应回归中，固定效应可能吸收大部分识别变异，仅留下少数观测值承载剩余变异。当变异如此集中时，传统的t检验在真实零假设下拒绝的概率可能超过一半，而任何固定的临界值要么无效，要么保守到几乎没有功效。本文仅基于设计构建了一个精确检验。一个“干扰消除对比”是处理变量与固定效应虚拟变量的线性组合，它消除固定效应而不影响结果变量；对这些对比进行符号翻转，在任意样本量下、在任意异方差性下，都是零分布的一个精确对称操作。在双向设计中——如工人-企业、企业-时间——这些对比恰好是二部流动图的环，因此识别处理效应的流动正是使精确推断成为可能的关键。
tldr: 本文提出了一种仅基于设计构建的精确检验方法，通过“干扰消除对比”和符号翻转，在固定效应回归中变异高度集中时仍能提供有效的推断，并揭示了双向设计中流动图环与精确推断的内在联系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an exact test built solely from the design, using nuisance-annihilating contrasts and sign-flipping to provide valid inference in fixed-effect regressions with highly concentrated identifying variation, revealing that cycles in the mobility graph enable exact inference in two-way designs.
